name: Alert trigger
description: Alert generated when one of the associated monitoring checks fails repeatedly.

name.label: Name
name.description: Display name inherited from the alert message model.

object_class.label: Target class
object_class.description: Class of the server or instance monitored by the alert trigger.
object_class.help: Automatically assigned from the related target. Empty for examples.

object_id.label: Target ID
object_id.description: Identifier of the server or instance monitored by the alert trigger.
object_id.help: Automatically assigned from the related target. Empty for examples.

scope.label: Scope
scope.description: Status-data scope required to evaluate this alert trigger.
scope.help: Only checks using this scope can be associated with the alert trigger.

repetition.label: Repetitions
repetition.description: Number of consecutive failed evaluations required before generating an alert.
repetition.help: For example, 2 requires the check to fail twice in a row.

checks_ids.label: Checks
checks_ids.description: Monitoring checks that can activate this alert trigger.

user_id.label: User
user_id.description: User concerned by the generated alert, if any.

group_id.label: Group
group_id.description: Group concerned by the generated alert, if any.

severity.label: Severity
severity.description: Severity assigned to alerts generated by this trigger.
severity.help: Controls the priority shown to alert recipients.

message_model_id.label: Message model
message_model_id.description: Message model used to generate the alert.
message_model_id.help: Its translated label is used as the alert trigger name.

alert_messages_ids.label: Alert messages
alert_messages_ids.description: Messages generated by this alert trigger.

form.default.name: Alert trigger
form.default.description: Create or edit an alert trigger.
